coverage.reason: Safety stop; no sustainable capacity inferred
No bidirectional shaping gateway; USB forwarding is not the specified WiFi network
No stable server load established after host memory safety stop
No production tokens/providers used; local SMTP sink and queue paths only
Bundled-image UI rounds and seeded network-image browsing are separate; no image-completion observer or controlled cache eviction was executed. First pass does not imply empty disk cache.

Login is functional setup and refresh is separately named in Locust setup metrics. A separate 30-sample authentication campaign was not completed after the host memory safety stop; authentication rate limits remain enabled.

Pagination uniqueness and nonempty category results are asserted; existing store Cubit regressions pass. The recorded mobile baseline does not assert restored scroll offset or all search-result contents, so it does not certify those flows.

APK sizes and device temperature/charging evidence are recorded. Profile sandbox disk use can be read with run-as; release private-data size may not be available. USB charging and one device prevent a battery-life conclusion.

The first session returned baseline and after20 heap snapshots but no completed 30-minute artifact. Its ignored logs and snapshots remain under yalla_market/build/performance/memory; the resumed session has a separate directory.

Collector targets 5 seconds and records actual timestamps. Docker block I/O and PostgreSQL cache/temp counters are collected; dedicated PostgreSQL device IOPS/latency and worker restart reasons need deeper host monitoring. No missing series is inferred as zero.

Three corrected attempts lost Flutter VM service connection before a raw result returned. Completion markers alone do not substitute for frame arrays. Legacy English browsing retained with motion limitations and invalid fake-client search.
Locust journeys request API endpoints only. Physical network-image browsing is a single-device functional workload, not concurrent image asset capacity.

Uninstall returned DELETE_FAILED_INTERNAL_ERROR, then install succeeded and firstInstallTime changed. The first post-install sample is preserved but independent clearance of previous private data was not verified. Cold-process and background samples are separate.

Completed 30-minute raw artifact and All tests passed log are preserved; outer PowerShell returned1 with native stderr warnings. Raw completion and snapshots support measurement, while shell status remains documented.
Three actual horizontal30s rounds returned FrameTiming and all passed. The same test later failed at Home due missing RegionHintCubit in its fixture. Valid offers results retained.

Home fixture missed NavigationMenuView provider. Harness corrected, but corrected version was not built or rerun before delivery. Earlier long-list frame rounds remain separate evidence; no resident count is fabricated.

Initial live-frame appContext was uninitialized before the route built. Harness now waits and corrected APK is built, but has not run. One actual Release purchase review passed; this does not substitute for30 latency samples.
